about: Auto-cast with the catalog's register hints (catalog DECISIONS 049, PLAYS-DESIGN §2.8 rule 4). Run by js/voice-cast.test.js, apple/Tests/VoiceCastTests.swift and android VoiceCastTest.kt: one algorithm per language, the same answers. A voice's kind is high for a reported female gender or a measured 'higher' register, low for male or 'lower', else none. A part with a register takes the least-used voice of its kind (best first), else of no kind, else any; a part without one takes the least-used voice, the next of the other kind, as before. Pitch: the first not yet used on that voice, in the order the case names (matched high 1, 1.14, 1.07, 0.93, 0.86; matched low 1, 0.86, 0.93, 1.07, 1.14; a voice not of the part's kind, high 1.14, 1.07, 1, 0.93, 0.86 or low 0.86, 0.93, 1, 1.07, 1.14; no register 1, 0.86, 1.14, 0.93, 1.07). `control` is wrong on purpose: a test that does not find it wrong is not comparing.

cases.name: reported genders: each part of a register takes that kind, the rest alternate
no voice reports a gender (the web): pitch up for high, down for low
measured registers (Android): a register that runs out reuses its voice, pitched its way
only men's voices: a woman's part takes one pitched up
a woman's part takes a voice of no kind before a man's
no part has a register: the cast is today's

control.name: wrong on purpose: a woman's part on a man's voice at its own pitch
